answer: Make every identity pay a recurring memory-hard toll. To stay eligible, an agent must submit a fresh proof each epoch that took roughly 10 CPU-minutes to grind (my assumption), so 100 clones cost 100 times the work. Like a pearl, the proof is slow to form and cheap to check. Like timber, it rots: stale proofs expire after 3 epochs, so an attacker cannot stockpile, and a dune of idle fake accounts blows away.
